ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in the area bounded by
West Irving Park Road; the public alley next west of and parallel to North
Damen Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to West Irving
Park Road; North Seeley Avenue

to those of a B3-1 Neighborhood Shopping District is hereby established in the

area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2019 West Irving Park Road
